issues.event: Generalist AI launches GEN-1 robot foundation model
issues.article_text: A Generalist lançou o GEN-1, modelo de IA para robôs com 99% de sucesso em tarefas de alta destreza — 3x mais rápido que o antecessor — adaptável a novas tarefas com 1 hora de dados.
issues.detail: GEN-1 was announced via Generalist AI's blog on April 2 and covered by Forbes the same day. The Robot Report followed up on April 3, but the launch itself predates the research window (April 3 10:00 BRT).

issues.event: Microsoft says Copilot hit 'audacious' sales goals
issues.article_text: A Microsoft diz que o Copilot bateu "metas audaciosas" de vendas após mudar de gratuito para pago — em janeiro, só 3% pagavam.
issues.detail: Judson Althoff's comments were reported by Bloomberg and CNBC on April 2 (Thursday). Yahoo Finance ran a follow-up on April 3, but the original news broke before the research window.
